MINUTES
  SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, APRIL 15, 2024 AT 8:00 A.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Chair Domier called the special meeting to order at 8:03 a.m. in the Barth
Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chair Domier led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Alternate Wahl, Alternate Wu, Trustee Chien, Trustee
  Osegueda, Vice Chair Sadun, Chair Domier

  ABSENT: Trustee Derry

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

1. CHAIR REPORT

Chair Domier reminded the Board that there are only two meetings left with the current group
Trustees and thanked everyone for their service. He encouraged all to consider applying for the
open Board positions. He shared that on April 22 he will be facilitating a discussion between the
Friends of the Crowell Public Library and the San Marino Public Library Foundation to encourage
further cooperation and explore any efficiencies.

2. TRUSTEE REPORTS

No reports were given at this time.

3. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

Vice Chair Sadun shared that Crain Art Gallery hosted an artist reception over the weekend, and
the work will remain up until May 24. She shared that the Committee will be meeting this week to
look at some new exhibits. She thanked Lynda Lyons for her work in coordinating the Rotary Club
exhibit, which entails an award reception later this month.

4. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
No report was given at this time.

5. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT

Trustee Chien shared that Delicious Destinations was a success, and that she will have more details
to present at the next meeting.

NEW BUSINESS

6. FY 2024-25 PROPOSED BUDGET

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

The Board expressed appreciation for the Library's FY 2024-25 objectives and asked clarifying
questions about the objective related to refreshing the Library's collection by I/3 each year.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

The following person(s) provided written communications or public writings:
  - None

ADIOURNMENT

Chair Dornier adjourned the meeting at 8:59 a.m.
